Fiscal 2024 figures, from memory of the 10-Ks:

**Procter & Gamble** (fiscal year ended June 30, 2024)
- Net sales: $84,039M
- Operating income: $18,314M
- Operating margin: about 21.8%

**Coca-Cola** (fiscal year ended December 31, 2024)
- Net operating revenues: $47,061M
- Operating income: $10,968M
- Operating margin: about 23.3%

Coca-Cola's margin is 23.3% against P&G's 21.8%, a gap of about 1.5 percentage points.

Calculations:
- P&G: 18,314 / 84,039 = 21.79%
- Coca-Cola: 10,968 / 47,061 = 23.31%
- Difference: 23.31 − 21.79 = 1.52 percentage points

**Coca-Cola had the higher operating margin, by about 1.5 percentage points.**
